answer: Producing 83 answers an epoch hence costs 99 real forward passes, and the knoll record lets any auditor recompute the check. Each answer is accompanied by a commitment to the inference that produced it: a model fingerprint plus a hash of the token logits, posted as a nectar header. Replaying a stored transcript fails because the challenge words differ every epoch, and fabricating a commitment fails a vertex spot-check that re-runs the prompt. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
